title: CAISI Director Chris Fall is resigning just three months after taking over the federal AI testing institute (Maria Curi/Axios)
summary: Maria Curi / Axios: CAISI Director Chris Fall is resigning just three months after taking over the federal AI testing institute — Chris Fall, the director of the Center for AI Standards and Innovation, is resigning just three months after taking over the federal AI testing institute, the Commerce Department confirmed on Tuesday.
